Knowledge Manager — Live Demo

Semantic search over 88 knowledge articles. User asks a question in natural language. System retrieves relevant chunks via embedding similarity, generates a cited answer, and returns source URLs.

Question: "How do I set up MFA?"

{ "reply": "...enable Security Defaults (free) or Conditional Access policies. Both let you enforce MFA for all users within a few clicks, with a grace period for users to enroll.", "citations": [ { "title": "How to set up multi-factor authentication on every account", "url": "https://klaravex.com/knowledge-base/multi-factor-authentication-setup/" } ], "match_type": "embedding" }

LIVE PRODUCTION Every answer cites its source. No hallucination — grounded in real KB articles.

Knowledge Base — More Examples

Question: "My computer is running slow"

"reply": "Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager. Click the Processes tab. Sort by CPU usage — look for anything using 20%+ consistently. If total memory usage is above 80-90%, that is causing slowdowns." "source": "klaravex.com/knowledge-base/slow-computer/"

Question: "How do I connect to the office VPN?"

"reply": "Cisco AnyConnect: Download from your company's IT portal. Enter the server address your IT team provides, sign in with corporate credentials. WireGuard: Install from wireguard.com, import the .conf file your IT team provides." "source": "klaravex.com/knowledge-base/vpn-setup/"

Each response is grounded in a specific KB article with a verifiable URL. The system does not generate answers from general training data.

Chat Widget — Embedded on Website

JavaScript widget deployed on production sites. Per-locale language detection (EN on .com, DE on .de). Real-time API calls with 12-second timeout. QuickReply buttons for common actions.

klaravex.com — chat widget visible bottom-right. Live production site.

Consumer Portal — Service Pages

11 consumer service pages with integrated chat, Stripe checkout, and booking flow.

personal.klaravex.com — consumer-facing portal with integrated AI chat.

Voice AI — 19 Assistants in Production

Phone-based AI voice system. Callers are triaged by language and intent, then routed to specialized assistants. Each assistant has specific tools (payment processing, troubleshooting, booking, client lookup).

Triage (EN/DE)

Language detection, consumer vs business fork, VIP gate, scam/elder-abuse hard escalation

Business Intake

New client qualification, 2-question fork to correct specialist

Business Engineer

Existing client routing via customer_code + lookup_client tool

Payment Processing

Generate Stripe checkout links via SMS/email during call

Remote Support

AI-guided RustDesk sessions with screen analysis

Specialized Pillars

Security, Regulatory, M365/Cloud, AI Adoption, Strategic

19 ASSISTANTS PRODUCTION Each assistant has tool access: payment links, ticket creation, client lookup, booking, escalation.
